ei.title: How Physical Touch Inhibits Plant Growth
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: How Physical Touch Inhibits Plant Growth

fullPassage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially inhibit their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how (A)[impactful / harmful] touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a (B)[dramatic / mild] response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially (C)[inhibit / boost] their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 접촉이 얼마나 '영향력 있는(impactful)'지 / (B) '극적인(dramatic)' 반응 / (C) 성장을 '억제(inhibit)'
det.analysis:
(A) impactful(영향력 있는): 접촉이 식물에 얼마나 '영향을 크게 미치는지' 보게 됐다는 흐름이라 impactful이 맞아요. harmful(해로운)은 본문이 말하려는 '영향력'과 초점이 달라요.

(B) dramatic(극적인): 호르몬과 유전자에 '극적인' 반응을 일으켰다는 뜻이라 dramatic이 맞아요. mild(약한)는 반대예요.

(C) inhibit(억제하다): 그 반응이 성장을 '억제할' 수 있었다는 흐름이라 inhibit이 맞아요. boost(촉진하다)는 정반대예요.

✅① impactful — dramatic — inhibit가 정답이고, ❌② harmful ❌③ mild ❌④ boost가 섞인 나머지는 오답이에요.
det.tip: 접촉이 성장을 억제(inhibit)한다는 글의 핵심 흐름으로 판단

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch (A)[quietly / loudly] triggered such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene expression that it could (B)[substantially / slightly] inhibit their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was (C)[altered / restored]. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 접촉이 '조용히(quietly)' 유발 / (B) 성장을 '상당히(substantially)' 억제 / (C) 유전체가 '바뀌었다(altered)'
det.analysis:
(A) quietly(조용히/은밀히): 접촉이 겉으론 티 안 나게 '조용히' 반응을 유발했다는 뜻이라 quietly가 맞아요. loudly(시끄럽게)는 어색해요.

(B) substantially(상당히): 성장을 '상당히' 억제할 수 있었다는 흐름이라 substantially가 맞아요. slightly(약간)는 정도가 반대예요.

(C) altered(바뀐): 유전체의 10%가 '바뀌었다'가 자연스러워요. restored(복원된)는 문맥과 안 맞아요.

✅③ quietly — substantially — altered가 정답이고, ❌① loudly ❌② slightly ❌④ restored가 섞인 나머지는 오답이에요.
det.tip: 접촉의 영향이 '상당히(substantially)' 컸다는 정도 표현에 주목

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a (A)[dramatic / dull] response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially inhibit their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then (B)[analyzed / ignored] the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and (C)[rerouting / storing] energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) '극적인(dramatic)' 반응 / (B) 반응을 '분석했다(analyzed)' / (C) 에너지를 '다른 데로 돌림(rerouting)'
det.analysis:
(A) dramatic(극적인): 접촉이 '극적인' 반응을 일으켰다는 흐름이라 dramatic이 맞아요. dull(밋밋한)은 반대예요.

(B) analyzed(분석했다): 연구자들이 식물의 유전적 반응을 '분석했다'가 자연스러워요. ignored(무시했다)는 실험 과정과 안 맞아요.

(C) rerouting(다른 곳으로 돌리는): 키 크는 일에서 에너지를 '다른 데로 돌린다'는 뜻이라 rerouting이 맞아요. storing(저장하는)은 문맥과 달라요.

✅② dramatic — analyzed — rerouting가 정답이고, ❌① dull ❌③ ignored ❌④ storing이 섞인 나머지는 오답이에요.
det.tip: 에너지를 성장 대신 '다른 곳으로 돌린다(rerouting)'는 후반부 흐름으로 판단

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how ①<u>impactful</u> touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly ②<u>triggered</u> such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially inhibit their growth. They ③<u>stroked</u> the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was ④<u>preserved</u>. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ preserved → altered: 유전체의 10%가 '바뀌었다(altered)'가 맞으므로 '보존되었다(preserved)'는 부적절
det.analysis:
① impactful(영향력 있는): 접촉이 식물에 얼마나 '영향력 있는지' — 맞아요.

② triggered(유발했다): 접촉이 반응을 '유발했다' — 맞아요.

③ stroked(부드럽게 쓰다듬었다): 붓으로 아라비돕시스를 '쓰다듬었다' — 맞아요.

④ preserved(보존된): 원문은 altered예요. 접촉 30분 안에 유전체의 10%가 '바뀌었다'는 흐름이라 '보존되었다'는 정반대라 부적절해요. ←정답
det.tip: 10%가 '바뀌었다(altered)' → 그대로 '보존(preserved)'은 반대

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a ①<u>dramatic</u> response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially ②<u>promote</u> their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then ③<u>analyzed</u> the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was ④<u>reorganizing</u> its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② promote → inhibit: 접촉이 성장을 '억제(inhibit)'한다는 글이므로 '촉진하다(promote)'는 부적절
det.analysis:
① dramatic(극적인): 호르몬에 '극적인' 반응 — 맞아요.

② promote(촉진하다): 원문은 inhibit이에요. 글 전체가 접촉이 성장을 '억제한다'는 내용이라, '촉진한다'는 정반대라 부적절해요. ←정답

③ analyzed(분석했다): 유전적 반응을 '분석했다' — 맞아요.

④ reorganizing(재정비하는): 식물이 우선순위를 '재정비하고' 있었다 — 맞아요.
det.tip: 제목처럼 접촉은 성장을 '억제(inhibit)' → promote(촉진)는 반대

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch ①<u>quietly</u> triggered such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene expression that it could ②<u>substantially</u> inhibit their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was ③<u>maintaining</u> its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis ④<u>cut</u> its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ maintaining → reorganizing: 식물이 우선순위를 '재정비했다(reorganizing)'가 맞으므로 '유지했다(maintaining)'는 부적절
det.analysis:
① quietly(조용히): 접촉이 '조용히' 반응을 유발했다 — 맞아요.

② substantially(상당히): 성장을 '상당히' 억제할 수 있었다 — 맞아요.

③ maintaining(유지하는): 원문은 reorganizing이에요. 방해에 대처하려고 우선순위를 '재정비하고(바꾸고)' 있었다는 흐름이라, 그대로 '유지한다'는 정반대라 부적절해요. ←정답

④ cut(줄였다): 여러 번 접촉하자 위로 자라는 속도를 '줄였다' — 맞아요.
det.tip: 방해에 대처하려고 우선순위를 '바꿈(reorganizing)' → 유지(maintaining)는 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: hormones — '호르몬과 유전자 발현'에 극적인 반응이 나타남
det.analysis:
① hormones(호르몬): 빈칸 뒤 'and gene expression(유전자 발현)'과 나란히 놓여, 접촉이 식물의 '호르몬'에 반응을 일으켰다는 흐름에 맞아요. ←정답

② muscles(근육): 식물에는 근육이 없어 어색해요.

③ roots(뿌리): 유전자 발현과 짝을 이루는 대상으로 어색해요.

④ leaves(잎): 문맥의 '유전적 반응'과 맞지 않아요.
det.tip: '___와 gene expression(유전자 발현)' → 생리 반응인 hormones(호르몬)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: priorities — 식물이 방해에 대처하려고 '우선순위(priorities)'를 재정비함
det.analysis:
① colors(색깔): 재정비 대상으로 어색해요.

② owners(주인): 식물이 주인을 재정비한다는 건 말이 안 돼요.

③ seasons(계절): 문맥과 무관해요.

④ priorities(우선순위): 방해(접촉)에 대처하려고 무엇을 먼저 할지 '우선순위'를 재정비했다는 흐름에 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: reorganizing its ___ to deal with the disturbance → priorities(우선순위)

det.korean: 빈칸: genome — 접촉 30분 안에 식물 '유전체(genome)'의 10%가 바뀜
det.analysis:

③ weight(무게): 유전 실험 맥락과 무관해요.

det.tip: genes(유전자) 실험 맥락 → 10 percent of the plant's genome(유전체)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 impactful과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: impactful(영향력 있는) = influential(영향력 있는)
det.analysis:
① harmless(무해한): 영향력과는 초점이 다르고 오히려 반대 느낌이에요.

② temporary(일시적인): 뜻이 전혀 달라요.

③ influential(영향력 있는): impactful은 '큰 영향을 미치는'이라 influential과 가장 가까워요. ←정답

④ visible(눈에 보이는): 관련 없어요.
det.tip: impactful = influential (영향을 크게 미치는)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 substantially와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: substantially(상당히) = considerably(상당히)
det.analysis:

② barely(거의 ~않게): 정도가 반대예요.

③ rarely(드물게): 빈도의 말이라 뜻이 달라요.

④ quickly(빨리): 속도의 말이라 관련 없어요.

det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 inhibit과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: inhibit(억제하다) ↔ promote(촉진하다)
det.analysis:
① restrain(억제하다): inhibit과 비슷한 뜻이라 반대가 아니에요(함정).

③ measure(측정하다): 의미축이 전혀 다른 단어예요.

④ reduce(줄이다): inhibit과 비슷한 쪽이라 반대가 아니에요(함정).
det.tip: inhibit(억제) ↔ promote(촉진) — restrain·reduce는 비슷한 뜻 함정

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a <u>dramatic</u> response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially inhibit their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 dramatic과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: dramatic(극적인/큰) ↔ mild(약한/미미한)
det.analysis:
① striking(눈에 띄는): dramatic과 비슷한 뜻이라 반대가 아니에요(함정).

② sudden(갑작스러운): 의미축이 다른 단어예요('갑작스러움'은 크기가 아니에요).

③ intense(강렬한): dramatic과 비슷한 쪽이라 반대가 아니에요(함정).

④ mild(약한/미미한): '극적인/큰'의 반대라 정답이에요. ←정답
det.tip: dramatic(극적인) ↔ mild(미미한) — striking·intense는 비슷한 뜻 함정

questions.passage: (A) Arabidopsis thaliana is a weedy plant in the mustard <u>family</u>, a group of species that scientists classify together. (B) Every Sunday, the whole <u>family</u> gathers around the table to share a big dinner together.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 family의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) family = (생물 분류상) 과 / (B) family = 가족
det.analysis:
(A) 'a plant in the mustard family(겨자 family에 속한 식물)'에서 family는 생물 분류 단위인 '과(科)'예요. 뒤에 '함께 분류하는 종의 집단'이라는 설명이 그 뜻을 확인해 줘요.

(B) '온 family가 식탁에 모인다'에서 family는 우리가 아는 '가족'이에요.

따라서 (A) 과 — (B) 가족인 ①번이 정답이에요.

✅① (A)과—(B)가족이 정답이고, ❌② ❌③ ❌④는 두 문맥 중 하나가 어긋나요.
det.tip: family: 생물학에서는 '과(분류군)', 일상에서는 '가족'

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to cause something to happen or begin, especially suddenly"

det.korean: 정의 = '무언가가 일어나거나 시작되게 하다(특히 갑자기)' → trigger(유발하다)
det.analysis:
① prevent(막다): 일어나지 못하게 막는 것이라 정의와 반대예요.

② delay(미루다): 시작을 늦추는 것이라 '일어나게 하다'와 달라요.

③ trigger(유발하다): '무언가가 일어나거나 시작되게 하다'라는 정의와 정확히 일치해요. 본문의 triggered(유발했다)와 같은 단어예요. ←정답

④ measure(측정하다): 뜻이 전혀 달라요.
det.tip: cause something to begin = 일어나게 하다 → trigger(유발하다)

questions.passage: Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene __________ (express) that it could substantially inhibit their growth.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: express(동사, 발현하다/표현하다) → expression(명사, 발현). 앞에 명사 gene이 꾸며 '유전자 발현'이라는 명사 자리예요.
det.analysis: 빈칸은 'their hormones and gene __________'로, 앞 명사 hormones와 and로 이어지는 명사 자리예요. 'gene expression(유전자 발현)'은 굳어진 명사 표현이라 동사 express를 명사형 expression으로 바꿔야 해요.
det.tip: express(동사) → -ion 붙여 expression(명사, 발현)

questions.passage: They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' __________ (gene) responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: gene(명사, 유전자) → genetic(형용사, 유전적인). 뒤의 명사 responses를 꾸미는 형용사 자리예요.
det.analysis: 빈칸은 'the plants' __________ responses'로, 뒤 명사 responses를 꾸미는 형용사 자리예요. 명사 gene을 형용사형 genetic으로 바꿔야 '유전적 반응'이 돼요.
det.tip: gene(명사) → -tic 붙여 genetic(형용사, 유전적인)

questions.passage: The genomics revolution made it possible to see just how impactful touch is to plants on a deeper level. Peering at the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, a weedy plant in the mustard family and the lab rat of the plant biology world, researchers saw that touch quietly triggered such a dramatic response in their hormones and gene expression that it could substantially inhibit their growth. They stroked the arabidopsis with soft paintbrushes, and then analyzed the plants' genetic responses. Within thirty minutes of being touched, 10 percent of the plant's genome was altered. Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to __________ the disturbance, and rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller. Touched multiple times, arabidopsis cut its upward growth rate by as much as 30 percent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: deal with — 식물이 방해(접촉)에 '대처하려고(deal with)' 우선순위를 재정비함
det.analysis:
① give up(포기하다): 방해를 '포기한다'는 어색해요.

② deal with(대처하다/다루다): 식물이 접촉이라는 방해에 '대처하려고' 우선순위를 재정비했다는 흐름에 맞아요. ←정답

③ call off(취소하다): 방해를 취소한다는 건 말이 안 돼요.

④ look after(돌보다): 방해를 '돌본다'는 어색해요.
det.tip: deal with the disturbance = 방해에 대처하다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: getting taller — 식물이 '키 크는(getting taller)' 힘든 일에서 에너지를 다른 데로 돌림
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'rerouting energy away from the hard work of __________(에너지를 __________라는 힘든 일에서 다른 데로 돌리며)'예요. 글의 핵심은 접촉이 '위로 자라는 성장'을 억제한다는 것이에요.

❌ ① storing water(물 저장): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.

❌ ② making seeds(씨앗 만들기): 언급이 없어요.

❌ ③ fighting pests(해충과 싸우기): 본문과 무관해요.

✅ ④ getting taller(키가 커지는 것): 바로 뒤 문장에서 '위로 자라는 속도(upward growth rate)를 줄였다'고 하니, 키 크는 일에서 에너지를 돌렸다는 흐름에 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: the hard work of getting taller = 키 크는 힘든 일 (뒤의 upward growth와 연결)
